releases.notes:
# Dash 5.0.0 - Autopilot, MCP, security and operations

Dash 5.0 is the biggest release so far. It also includes everything from 4.5.1 (the Minecraft 26.3 release that was never published on Modrinth), so you can update straight from 4.5.

Every feature below is in Dash for Paper, FabricDash and ForgeDash. Loader limits on FabricDash and ForgeDash: the update manager cannot run a trial in the Shadow Boot Lab on a mod server (it says so and never reports a pass; installing needs an explicit override); the update swap on Windows with Fabric completes only after the server process ends; a restart needs a launcher script or host that starts the server again; the apply and appeal hints in the join message are Paper only; chat moderation has no bypass permission (operators can be exempt) and Fabric cannot rewrite a message, it refuses it and sends the censored text as a system line.

## Material 3 Expressive interface and 14 languages

- Rebuilt every page on Material 3 Expressive: navigation rail and drawer, phone layout with bottom bar, dark and light themes, shared components and Material tooltips.
- Added a language switcher with 14 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese. Each user keeps a personal choice or follows the browser; the sign-in page respects it too.
- Pages that are new in 5.0 show English text in some languages until their translations are complete.
- Stylesheets, scripts and dictionaries are served under content-hashed paths, so a new release is never shown with stale cached assets.
- Sessions survive panel restarts, and the restart watcher recognises the panel as soon as it answers.

## Autopilot

- Explained findings: confidence with the factors behind it, evidence lines, alternatives and what would change the diagnosis.
- Modes Off, Suggest (default), Approve and Auto, with guardrails: daily cap, cooldown, quiet hours, deny list, restarts only when allowed.
- Every action is journaled, verified afterwards and can be undone; the Autopilot card is shown on the dashboard.
- Paper: learning statistics with a suggested confidence threshold (never applied automatically), custom rules ("if this error then notify or propose"), and a pause after you reject a proposal.
- NeoDash: fleet warnings check every server that runs the same plugin when one server has a problem.

## AI access (MCP) replaces the internal Dash AI

- The internal Dash AI and its Gemini integration are removed; stored provider keys are deleted at the first start.
- New MCP server (`POST /mcp`, Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0) with read and action tools for status, console, players, Guardian, diagnoses, Autopilot, backups, plugins, files, audit log and tickets. Off by default; only the Main Admin switches it on.
- Scoped API tokens (`dash_pat_...`) with a read and write API under `/api/v1`: a token never does more than its owner may do. Tokens expire, can be rotated and are shown only once.
- Per-tool switches, a kill switch, rate limits, output masking and an audit entry for every call.
- NeoDash offers fleet tools over MCP as well.

## Security

- Two-factor login for every user (authenticator app with locally generated QR code, ten recovery codes, policy for everyone or selected roles) and passkeys.
- Session overview with sign-out of single devices and alerts for new devices.
- IP allow-list with trusted proxies, lock-out preview and the console switch `/dash allowlist off`.
- Signed audit log: hash chain with signed checkpoints, export and verification in the panel or offline.
- Guided secret rotation for the bridge secret (with connection test and automatic rollback), Discord webhooks and API tokens.

## Operations

- Scheduled restarts with countdown, player warnings and an optional quiet window.
- One-click maintenance mode with whitelist, server-list message, polite kick and automatic end.

...

releases.notes:
# FabricDash 4.5

FabricDash 4.5 completes the post-4.0 interface and workflow updates for Fabric servers.

## Reports and Player Care

- Added `/dash ticket` and `/dash report <player>` for all players without granting dashboard access.
- Added short-lived, single-use HTTPS links to a dedicated report-only page with no login prompt or access to other routes.
- Added bounded automatic context, staff replies, status and priority controls, notes, deletion, filtering and pagination.
- Rebuilt player results as responsive cards with avatars, interactive 3D skin rendering and a static fallback.
- Added visible linked Dash-account state and permission-aware account actions.

## Everyday Administration

- Added first-run Light, Normal (recommended) and Full functionality profiles, plus a separate beta opt-in.
- Added per-feature availability settings and persistent sidebar drag, hide and restore controls for mouse and touch.
- Added folder downloads as ZIP files, whole-row navigation and uploads that preserve the current page position.
- Combined installed mod management with Modrinth results filtered by Fabric and the exact Minecraft version.
- Fixed Console Clear and made graph ranges fetch and render their real historical datasets.
- Added graph live/pause, tooltips, empty states and JSON/CSV export.

## Advanced Workspaces

- Added the full Intelligence feature set and bounded Shadow Boot execution.
- Condensed Guardian into paged investigation, case, protection, recovery and retention workflows.
- Replaced Doctor with optional Dash AI and retained deterministic diagnostics in Maintenance.
- Added server-side Gemini keys, consent, redaction, cancellable streaming, model and thinking controls, local quota limits and 30-day conversation retention.
- Kept mutations behind expiring proposals, permission rechecks, reasons, confirmation, replay prevention, restore points and audits.

## Compatibility and Interface

- Ships dedicated Fabric builds for Minecraft 1.21 through 1.21.11 and 26.2.
- Uses Java 21 for 1.21.x and Java 25 for 26.2, with Fabric Loader 0.19.5+.
- Expanded English and Spanish coverage and refined route motion, loading feedback, responsive layouts and reduced-motion behavior.
- Preserved signed NeoDash SSO and the configured HTTPS return origin.

# FabricDash Release Notes

## 4.0 - 2026-07-06

FabricDash 4.0 is the major Fabric release after 3.1. It brings the new Dash motion system, a cleaner Guardian experience, stronger file interactions and clearer GitHub-backed update workflows to Fabric servers.

### Motion and interface polish

- Rebuilt the shared animation layer for smoother page transitions, content swaps, card entrances, row reveals, hover lift, press feedback, status flips and value flashes.
- Removed the bumpy feel when switching pages.
- Preserved reduced-motion support.
- Tuned transitions around transform/opacity patterns for a smoother browser experience.

### Guardian

- Shortened the Guardian activity area with a fixed-height, scrollable table surface.
- Added paging for Timeline, Blocks and Containers.
- Added sticky activity headers for easier scanning.
- Spread Guardian tools across a full-width responsive grid instead of stacking everything in one right-side column.
- Kept cases, notes, rollback, incidents, scores, replay, restore, alert rules, retention, purge and import tools available.

### Files and mods

- File and folder rows now open from the whole bubble, not only the name.
- Upload, edit, rename, download and delete flows keep the operator in context.
- Fabric mod maintenance remains local to FabricDash with installed mod state, jar upload and Modrinth search.

### GitHub and update workflows

- GitHub-backed release checks remain targeted at `Framepersecond/FabricDash`.
- Update scans are rate-limit aware and manual scans can retry when needed.
- Staged updates apply through the Fabric `mods` workflow.

### NeoDash bridge

- Restart from a NeoDash SSO session delegates to NeoDash's configured start path.
- Restart redirects into NeoDash startup-log visibility for Fabric servers.
- Bridge values are stored consistently with Dash and ForgeDash.

### Release metadata

- Gradle `mod_version` updated to `4.0`.
- Fabric metadata now points to the FabricDash GitHub repository.

## 3.1 - Previous Release

FabricDash 3.1 introduced the first premium motion pass, local Fabric maintenance, Modrinth browser support, notifications, staff workflow, graph snapshots, mobile navigation fixes and NeoDash restart handoff.

releases.notes:
## 3.1 - 2026-06-02

### Premium interface motion
- Aligned FabricDash with the refreshed Dash motion system.
- Improved page transitions, card entrance timing, row reveals, status flips, value flashes, hover lift, active press feedback, and navigation feedback.
- Tuned animation curves and browser-friendly transform/opacity usage for a smoother Chrome experience.
- Kept reduced-motion support for users who prefer minimal animation.

### Controls and menus
- Reworked selection controls so native dropdowns fit the dashboard visual language better.
- Improved file-manager menus with smoother pop-in behavior and clearer per-file actions.
- Preserved the existing dashboard structure while adding premium micro-interactions.

### Release
- Mod metadata updated to version `3.1`.

## Latest (Fabric stabilization update)

### Core fixes
- Fixed command execution wiring from dashboard/home.
- Fixed player profile/action routing regressions.
- Reworked freeze to a true movement lock with title feedback.
- Fixed item-give/enderchest give action mapping.

### Files + paths
- Unified server-root resolution across panel features.
- Fixed file browser showing empty results when run-directory resolution was wrong.
- File upload/download/edit/delete/rename now use the same resolved server root.

### Settings
- MOTD now persists to the correct `server.properties` and applies live.
- View/simulation distance persistence and runtime application improved.
- Gamerule action handling aligned with UI controls.

### Backups + datapacks
- Backup content collection fixed for resolved server root and world paths.
- Empty/tiny invalid backup archives are now prevented (explicit failure instead).
- Datapack upload/toggle/delete flow stabilized.

### Updater
- Updater repository target is `Framepersecond/FabricDash`.
- Update staging/apply path uses Fabric `mods/` workflow.
- GitHub rate-limit detection now pauses **automatic checks for 24 hours**.
- Manual **Scan for Updates** bypasses backoff and can force a retry immediately.

### UI / Fabric alignment
- Sidebar and settings wording updated to **Mods** (Fabric context).
- Fabric-only settings cleanup (removed Spark/DiscordSRV-specific UI expectations).

releases.notes:
### 🐛 Bug Fixes

#### Console Command Arrow Button (`type="submit"`)
- **Fixed**: The arrow/send button in the dashboard console command bar was missing `type="submit"`, causing the form to fail submission in many browser environments when clicking the icon.
- **Fix**: Added `type="submit"` to the `<button>` element.

### ✨ New Features

#### Live Telemetry Metrics — MSPT & Chunk Split
- `/api/stats` now returns `mspt`, `overworld_chunks`, `nether_chunks`, `end_chunks` mirroring Spigot API parity
- Dashboard's Chunk Split chart and MSPT/Chunks KPI cards now populate from live data immediately without requiring history to accumulate

#### Hover-Lift Micro-Animations — All Pages
- `.dash-hover-lift` animation applied to all interactive cards and list items across:
  - Dashboard player rows, KPI and chart cards, player sidebar
  - Files page items, Plugins tiles, Settings panels, Permissions panels, Scheduled Tasks cards
